viewport-organization.copy: Viewport behavior follows Density and Frame: one column when space is tight, grouped rows only when labels, helper text, and states remain readable.

items.title: Smartphones + phablets
items.rule: Stack fields full-width with visible helper or recovery copy.

items.title: Tablets + laptops
items.rule: Group related fields when labels and helper text remain readable.

items.title: Desktops + TV
items.rule: Use larger inspector fields for remote viewing or review surfaces.
